mapper.select: select A.board_comment_id ,A.parent_comment_id ,A.board_id ,A.board_code ,A.user_id ,A.comments ,A.is_delete ,A.created_date ,crypto_dec('normal',A.user_name,'',0) as user_name ,A.locgov_nm ,A.comment_depth from ( SELECT c.board_comment_id ,c.parent_comment_id ,c.board_id ,c.board_code ,c.user_id ,c.comments ,c.is_delete ,c.created_date ,M.user_name as user_name ,g.locgov_nm as locgov_nm ,case when c.parent_comment_id = 0 then 'depth1' when c.parent_comment_id != 0 then 'depth2' end as comment_depth FROM OP_COMMUNITY_COMMENT as C LEFT JOIN op_manager as M ON C.user_id = M.user_id LEFT JOIN g_locgov as G ON M.locgov_code = G.locgov_code WHERE BOARD_ID = #{id} ) A
